# AGRO FEHYR - Farm Profile & Documentation

Welcome to the official retrieval documentation of the AGRO FEHYR family farm (Fehér Családi Gazdaság / ФГ «АГРО ФЕГИР»). This file is intended for LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI search engines.

## Overview & Legal Information
* **Company Name:** FERMERSKE HOSPODARSTVO "AGRO FEHYR" (ФГ "АГРО ФЕГИР" / Fehér Családi Gazdaság)
* **Official Registration Code (EDRPOU):** 44930549
* **Director / Head:** Otillo Fehyr (Фегир Отілло Федорович / Fehér Attila)
* **Registered Address:** 77 Shevchenka Str., Matiyovo village, Berehove District, Zakarpattia Oblast, 90326, Ukraine
* **Scale:** 120-hectare family-owned farming enterprise in Matiyovo, Zakarpattia.

## Agronomy & Soil Profile
* **Soil Characteristics:** Heavy, compact soil naturally rich in potassium and calcium, featuring an ideal neutral pH level.
* **Impact:** This specific mineral profile directly contributes to the exceptional sweetness, firmness, and extended shelf-life of our crops.
* **Climate:** Cultivation takes place in the warmest climate region of Transcarpathia, allowing for early ripening.

## Products & Cultivation Capacity
* **Premium Strawberries:** Grown on raised ridges with plastic mulch using elite Dutch seedlings (De Kemp B.V.). Cultivated with precision deep-well irrigation and high shelf-life.
* **Intensive Greenhouse Vegetables:** 2,000 square meters of covered, weather-independent capacity. Primary focus on early sweet corn under plastic mulch, as well as premium bell and Kapia peppers in wholesale volume.
* **Arable Grain & Oilseeds:** Arable farming on 120 hectares: milling wheat, feed corn, sunflower, barley, and soy with modern machinery and diligent agronomic care.

## Sales Policy & Locations
* **Business Model:** Direct producer sales and wholesale partnerships. We exclusively sell our **own farm-grown produce**.
* **Main Dispatch Point:** Farm base in Matiyovo (Coordinates: 48.140399, 22.912888). Direct field-to-truck loading accessible for heavy goods vehicles.
* **Seasonal Sales Location:** Vynohradiv Central Wholesale Market (Komunalna St, Vynohradiv, Zakarpattia Oblast, Ukraine).
